system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Model this mission for a fixed-base articulated manipulator named SCARACarryB: Lift and reposition a rigid tool payload while preserving the requested end-effector orientation. The physical system is as follows. A 28 kg cylindrical base supports two revolute Z links of 0.48 m and 0.34 m followed by a prismatic Z carriage with 0.30 m travel; moving masses are 6 kg, 4 kg, and 2 kg. Three saturated joint-space actuators command the two rotations and vertical slide and the allowed command magnitude is 77.9 N.m-or-900-N. Use a rigid workcell floor and a fixed table represented with collision enabled. Instrument the scenario as follows: Joint encoders and a six-axis wrist wrench sensor provide feedback. Control it using computed-torque control with bounded wrist-force correction. During the middle third, inject a controlled 8.4 kg payload disturbance. Run at 100 Hz for 10 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require joint and effort bounds, wrist force below 60 N, payload retention, and pose tracking, primary tracking error below 0.054 rad-or-m after 6.5 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
